steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Hello? Excuse me? Is anyone home? There's no way you'd be refusing to pick up again, right?

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Hello? Ah, ohh! There, there you are!

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Hey, I finally got through...

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: You should've made it over there already, yeah? So, how's Siesta?

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Get a load of this. The Doctor said it's so hot over there, people sometimes pass out on the streets. Then, they get woken up later with free beer. That true?

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Ah, by the way, which celebrities did they book for the music festival this time? Is the Emperor gonna be there?

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Oh, have you seen anyone from Alive Until Sunset? I play their songs as my background music. Listen to this one—

steps.name: Thorns
steps.text: If you have something to say, spit it out already. Otherwise, I'm hanging up.

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Wait, hold up, c'mon bro, don't be like that!

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: I do have something to tell you, so don't hang up, man!

steps.name: Thorns
steps.text: Sigh...

steps.name: Thorns
steps.text: If you wanted to come that badly, why aren't you here?

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Because I can't, man! Did you think I wanted to stay behind?

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Since all you guys went, someone had to stay behind on the ship. Plus, I also had some internal stuff to deal with. You know, that Gavial, she—

steps.name: Thorns
steps.text: Stop. Don't tell me about your missions.

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Eh, it's nothing classified. But still, there is that one thing that's rather...

steps.name: Thorns
steps.text: If it's important, get to the point. Thirty words or less.

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Not cool, bro.

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Has anyone ever told you you can be a real wet blanket at times?

steps.name: Thorns
steps.text: Nope.

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Poor chap. They must all be too afraid to tell you the truth.

steps.name: Thorns
steps.text: I'm hanging up.

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Fine, fine, I'll cut to the chase!

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Sigh...

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: The source isn't that reliable but there might be some trouble at this music festival but since I know you don't really care about that please ask for an autograph if you happen to bump into anyone from Alive Until Sunset! Big thanks in advance!

steps.name: Thorns
steps.text: ...Is that all?

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Huh? Uh, yeah.

steps.name: Thorns
steps.text: That was forty-five words. You went over by fifty percent.

steps.name: Thorns
steps.text: And, if you blast music at that volume in the office, the Engineering Department will be there to smash your stereo within ten seconds.

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Wait a sec. Did you need something... Disturbing the work environment? What are you talking ab— ...Aaaah, my bad, ignore what I just said, seriously, it's my fault, please stoppp—

steps.name: Thorns
steps.text: Tch.

steps.name: Thorns
steps.text: Just how much does this guy like that band?

steps.name: Thorns
steps.text: I can almost recite the lyrics myself...... Hmm?

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: The scenery out here is amazing, but it really is hot and humid! I can practically wring out my wet tail!

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: The temperature here in Siesta seems even higher than I expected, which is weird... Hey, Skyfire, don't you think so too?

steps.name: Skyfire
steps.text: Considering the way we're dressed, it'd be stranger not to be hot.

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: Eh, good point.

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: Everyone's too dressed up anyway. Someone might seriously get heat stroke like this, so let's get changed already... Besides, I heard we might have a chance to head down to the beach, so I brought a swimsuit.

steps.name: Skyfire
steps.text: Hold up, not yet! Weren't we going to go to the base of the volcano? You'll have to wait until we get back first!

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: Let's hurry up and get it over with then. I want to kick back and relax on the beach too, y'know. Not every day we get a chance like this!

steps.name: Thorns
steps.text: The beach... and the ocean?

steps.name: Thorns
steps.text: ...It doesn't smell like the sea here.

steps.name: Alty
steps.text: Phew, how many songs was that? We still have another performance tonight. Don't get all excited and blow your energy this early.

steps.name: Aya
steps.text: No clue, but I'm still having a good time. Frost, you too, right?

steps.name: Frost
steps.text: (Plucks a chord)

steps.name: Dan
steps.text: Not like it matters. Nothing's going to burn us out.

steps.name: Alty
steps.text: Ahaha... Yeah, I guess that's true.

steps.name: Alty
steps.text: All righty, then. Before the night comes—

steps.name: Alty
steps.text: Let's party hard! !

steps.name: Thorns
steps.text: (Is this the band that guy is so crazy about? They seem like a really noisy bunch.)

steps.name: Thorns
steps.text: (Also...)

steps.name: Thorns
steps.text: (Something's weird about them. Can't put my finger on it though.)

steps.name: Thorns
steps.text: (Is it because of this song? What exactly... is this familiar feeling?)

steps.name: Bodyguard A
steps.text: Have you found the Young Miss?!

steps.name: Bodyguard B
steps.text: Hurry up! After them, they couldn't have gotten far!

steps.name: Bodyguard A
steps.text: This way, we have to bring her back!

steps.name: Fan A
steps.text: Hey, stop squeezing! How rude!

steps.name: Fan B
steps.text: Who the hell stepped on my foot?

steps.name: Fan C
steps.text: Who cares about those people? It's time for the next song! Woooah, it's the first song off their album Deep Color in the Sea!

steps.name: Thorns
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Thorns
steps.text: (Just now, who were those people looking for?)

steps.name: Thorns
steps.text: (Based on the way they're dressed, they're no ordinary group of civilians...)
Excuse me, sorry, let me through please!

steps.name: Vigna
steps.text: Phew, I finally made it out...

steps.name: Thorns
steps.text: What's the hurry?

steps.name: Vigna
steps.text: Eep! Who are you?!

steps.name: Vigna
steps.text: Oh, it's Thorns... Don't scare me like that... Anyway, since you're here, does that mean you're also a fan of Alive Until Sunset?

steps.name: Vigna
steps.text: Right, I just remembered, you're also Ægirian. Feels like every Ægir I've met has some special connection with them. The sea they sing about is so much more beautiful and intense than the waves of Siesta!

steps.name: Vigna
steps.text: Ah, crap, that's not what I'm supposed to be talking about!

steps.name: Vigna
steps.text: The Doctor and the others seem to be in a bit of a pickle, so I'm on my way to help out! Since you're already here, don't just stand around, let's go help out—

steps.name: Thorns
steps.text: There's no need for me to go.

steps.name: Vigna
steps.text: Huh? Why's that?

steps.name: Thorns
steps.text: They have the old geezer from Ursus with them this time. They'll be fine.

steps.name: Thorns
steps.text: ...Uhh, that came out wrong. Rather...

steps.name: Thorns
steps.text: I did not receive any direct communications, which means my presence is not required.

steps.name: Thorns
steps.text: I fully expect that the Doctor has a level of control over the situation. A commander of that caliber would never do anything to endanger our operators.

steps.name: Thorns
steps.text: Until I've received specific instructions, there is no need for me to participate in your operation.

steps.name: Thorns
steps.text: Don't underestimate the Doctor and rush to your own arbitrary decisions. You may end up causing more harm than good.

steps.name: Thorns
steps.text: That's what I've inferred. Are there any issues?

steps.name: Vigna
steps.text: None.

steps.name: Vigna
steps.text: None at all. But, I did figure something out.

steps.name: Vigna
steps.text: You and I. We definitely aren't getting along! Imagine having to think that much every time anybody asks you something!

steps.name: Vigna
steps.text: Oops, I don't even know why I'm talking to you. The Doctor asked for my help, not yours. Right?

steps.name: Vigna
steps.text: All right, you just sit here and keep enjoying the show. I have somewhere to be.

steps.name: Thorns
steps.text: What's with her tone?

steps.name: Thorns
steps.text: I don't get it.

steps.name: Male Tourist
steps.text: Have you heard, there's a barbecue stall in the food court by the beach? They're having a half-off deal, and the line's snaking all the way out to the street!

steps.name: Male Tourist
steps.text: How about it? Wanna see what the hype is all about?

steps.name: Female Tourist
steps.text: Barbecue, in this weather? It's way too hot, I think I'll pass...

steps.name: Male Tourist
steps.text: Hey, don't be like that. Is there anything better for the fiery atmosphere of this music festival than some barbecue on the hot beach next to a raging charcoal fire?

steps.name: Male Tourist
steps.text: And with so many people lined up, I bet the flavor's out of this world! It'd be a shame not to give it a try!

steps.name: Male Tourist
steps.text: We're on vacation, and we came all the way out here. C'mon, my treat!

steps.name: Female Tourist
steps.text: You're talking just like my aunts and uncles... But fine, since you're so worked up about this, let's go check it out.

steps.name: Female Tourist
steps.text: Huh? What's the sound over there?

steps.name: AUS
steps.text: What did y'all say?

steps.name: AUS
steps.text: C'mon, louder! I can't hear you—

steps.name: Fan A
steps.text: ONE— MORE— SONG—!!

steps.name: Fan B
steps.text: ENCORE—!!

steps.name: Male Tourist
steps.text: Looks like they set up a temporary stage. Not sure which band is performing on this street though.

steps.name: Female Tourist
steps.text: Don't you think that's much more interesting than some barbecue? Look at all the people there - what if that's some famous musician...

steps.name: Female Tourist
steps.text: Hey, who hit me?!

steps.name: Thorns
steps.text: Watch out.

steps.name: Female Tourist
steps.text: Ah, uh.... Um, th-thank you...

steps.name: Male Tourist
steps.text: Woah, that's rad! They're way too awesome! !

steps.name: Female Tourist
steps.text: I've never heard this band before! The scene here is even better than I imagined...

steps.name: Female Tourist
steps.text: I knew I made the right call. Enjoying some good music is way better than barbecue in the middle of the summer! I don't know when they're releasing their next album, but I'll definitely buy it!

steps.name: Male Tourist
steps.text: I see how it is. You're just not into barbecue...

steps.name: Female Tourist
steps.text: You only now realize...?

steps.name: Male Tourist
steps.text: Alright, let's drop it. By the way, where's your purse?

steps.name: Female Tourist
steps.text: ...Huh?

steps.name: Female Tourist
steps.text: I could've sworn I had it with me...

steps.name: Thorns
steps.text: Are you looking for this?

steps.name: Unremarkable Tourist
steps.text: Eep!

steps.name: Unremarkable Tourist
steps.text: What have you done? How could you just strike me like that?! Gyaaaaaaaah, my arm! Aaaargh!!

steps.name: Thorns
steps.text: Stop your sniveling. It's not broken.

steps.name: Thorns
steps.text: I hate noise. Should I shut you up some other way?

steps.name: Unremarkable Tourist
steps.text: (Gurgles strangely as if his throat is being pinched)

steps.name: Thorns
steps.text: Here.

steps.name: Female Tourist
steps.text: Oh, my purse!

steps.name: Thorns
steps.text: Two watches, four wallets, and a woman's bracelet. It seems that being immersed in music can indeed cause one to let her guard down. Everyone is alike in that regard.

steps.name: Thorns
steps.text: It must've been quite easy to get your hands on these things. Otherwise, you wouldn't have the gall to do it again and again.

steps.name: Unremarkable Tourist
steps.text: Wh-what are you talking about?! These are mine! They belong to me...

steps.name: Thorns
steps.text: Rubbish.

steps.name: Thorns
steps.text: Your slipshod lie is an utter waste of my time.

steps.name: Female Tourist
steps.text: Y-yeah! That clearly is my purse!

steps.name: Male Tourist
steps.text: Huh? There really are thieves running around? Maybe those black suits back there were chasing after thieves!

steps.name: Thorns
steps.text: Black suits? They are not so well-intentioned.

steps.name: Thorns
steps.text: Make sure to hold on to your things. If there is nothing else, I need to bring this one to his other victims.

steps.name: Unremarkable Tourist
steps.text: Wh-wh-wh-what are you talking about?! What victims?!

steps.name: Unremarkable Tourist
steps.text: Let me go right now or I'm reporting you to—

steps.name: Thorns
steps.text: Silence.

steps.name: Unremarkable Tourist
steps.text: Gyaahhhh! !

steps.name: Male Tourist
steps.text: Um, Mister, of course, we believe you're in the right, but how do you know where these other victims are?

steps.name: Male Tourist
steps.text: How could you find them?

steps.name: Thorns
steps.text: ...People like these often wait in places where crowds gather, specifically targeting foreign tourists before making off with their ill-gotten gains.

steps.name: Thorns
steps.text: This is a repeat offender.

steps.name: Thorns
steps.text: I made sure of this when I saw him strike the second time. I then followed him for five blocks to find his group's hideout.

steps.name: Thorns
steps.text: Don't act so surprised. You'll be able to see the others soon, at the police station.

steps.name: Thorns
steps.text: The one with the scar is your leader, right? He was pretty capable, and took me a bit of time.

steps.name: Unremarkable Tourist
steps.text: ...You even caught Old Tom? Tch... Should've said so earlier. All right, if you're that capable, I'll give up this time.

steps.name: Male Tourist
steps.text: Heh, you've been caught, and you're still talking big?

steps.name: Unremarkable Tourist
steps.text: Siesta is our city. What the hell do you know? So what if I'm caught? I'm just gonna get locked up for a bit...

steps.name: Male Tourist
steps.text: You piece of... Forget it, there's nothing worth saying to someone like you. Hey, Mister. I really can't thank you enough.

steps.name: Thorns
steps.text: Don't worry about it.

steps.name: Female Tourist
steps.text: Ah, wait, wait up! Where are you going?

steps.name: Thorns
steps.text: I don't need any reward.

steps.name: Thorns
steps.text: I was simply on the way to help my friend sort out some trouble. Just took a little detour.

steps.name: Female Tourist
steps.text: Don't say that! Let me show some appreciation!

steps.name: Female Tourist
steps.text: Besides, you're pretty cute. Want to get barbecue together?

steps.name: Female Tourist
steps.text: I heard there's a stall with a line around the block, the food there is supposed to be amazing. Since we're on vacation anyway, how about heading down together to give it a try? I'll treat you~!

steps.name: Male Tourist
steps.text: Wait a second... Didn't you just say you weren't into barbecue??

steps.name: Female Tourist
steps.text: That was a totally different situation though?

steps.name: Cutter
steps.text: That should wrap it up for this batch of customers. Do we still have time? Also, the fire's starting to die down. I need to add more charcoal.

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: I got you! Watch this!

steps.name: Thorns
steps.text: Is this the barbecue stall everyone's been talking about? Hm, I must say, this does look quite promising.

steps.name: Thorns
steps.text: But, the charcoal you're using...

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: Haah? Wait up, who the hell are you? Stop messing with my stuff!

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: Hold up, that weapon of yours. I swear I've seen it before... Lemme think... Eyy, no, no hints! I know I've seen you somewhere before!

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: Nnnnnnngh... Aren't you the one following the Doctor around a while ago? Ah, no, that's not right. That guy doesn't look like you. 'cept he was wearing a black cloak, and his sword wasn't that long.

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: I got it! You're the guy who was running circles around the deck yelling his head off, right?! I knew it! I'm sure of it! The one time that mean lady from Yan ran out screaming all those bad words, she was scolding you, wasn't she?

steps.name: Cutter
steps.text: Ifrit, the one running around was Mr. Elysium.

steps.name: Cutter
steps.text: I actually remember what he was yelling: 'I'm the one who drank your smoothie!'

steps.name: Cutter
steps.text: Miss Leizi was upset with him because she left the smoothie in the refrigerator.

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: Why was he yelling something like that then? Makes no sense. If you're gonna do something bad, why shout it out to everyone?

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: And how'd you find out anyway, big-ears?

steps.name: Thorns
steps.text: Because he and I were betting on whether the next operator to pass would be male or female. He lost.

steps.name: Cutter
steps.text: I was the one who passed by.

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: The hell? And I get treated like a kid?

steps.name: Thorns
steps.text: Sorry to interrupt, but your meat is about to burn.

steps.name: Thorns
steps.text: Had you turned it over thirty-six seconds ago, you might've still been able to achieve a medium-well state. If you turn off the heat now, you could still have a chance to save the flavor.

steps.name: Thorns
steps.text: Also, if I'm not mistaken, the charcoal you just added to the stove is damp, and within the next ten seconds, there is a 73% probability that it will explode.

steps.name: Thorns
steps.text: Hmm, considering the current state of the smoke and the attendant sparks, I'd have to increase that probability by ten percentage points.

steps.name: Cutter
steps.text: Uhh...

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: Uhh...

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: Uhh— Pffffff! *cough* *cough* Pffff! Pffff!

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: Damn it, why does this busted old stove just decide to explode? Can't you control it a little better? I barely gave it any heat at all!

steps.name: Cutter
steps.text: *cough* *cough* Sorry, it's my fault. I shouldn't have tried to do that after all. I thought it'd be fine if I just helped grill something...

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: Huh? Nah, you didn't do anything wrong.

steps.name: Cutter
steps.text: I'm very sorry, Ifrit, Mr. Thorns. And to all our guests as well. I will compensate you for your losses.

steps.name: Cutter
steps.text: ...I'm not going to hold you back any more, Ifrit. It's all you now.

steps.name: Thorns
steps.text: In other words, you're quitting? Just giving up?

steps.name: Cutter
steps.text: No. It's not that I'm giving up, I just don't want to cause any more trouble.

steps.name: Cutter
steps.text: This wouldn't be the first time, or the second. It's the same as when I was on the ship. Every time I enter the kitchen, there's always some kind of accident. Every time, without fail...

steps.name: Thorns
steps.text: Then, try again.

steps.name: Thorns
steps.text: If there's something you don't know, go learn it. If you fail once, fail a second time. If you fail a second time, fail a third time. Now that you know the cause of the accident, avoid it next time.

steps.name: Thorns
steps.text: Compensation is unnecessary. Accidental explosions of this magnitude occur all the time, and are insubstantial.

steps.name: Cutter
steps.text: Ifrit, I...

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: How long are you going to slack off?

steps.name: Cutter
steps.text: Huh? Huh?

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: I said, how long are you going to slack off?! C'mon, damn it! Hold this! I wanna get the stove set up again!

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: Stop gawking and get back to work already! You're the one who ran over here asking to help out, so don't you dare think of slinking off!

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: Hurry it up! Once it's done, you grill the next batch of meat. I'll change the charcoal!

steps.name: Cutter
steps.text: Me? Are you sure?

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: Got a problem? Nobody ever said you can't. Or, did you decide that yourself?

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: Tch, what a pain. This box is buried so damned deep in the sand, and it's so heavy you can't even dig it out.

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: Hey, where's the pepper? Why the hell is there no more pepper? Argh...! This is pissing me off!
Excuse me, I've heard of some delicious barbecue being sold here. Would you happen to know where that is?
Oh, it's Ifrit and Cutter.

steps.name: Beeswax
steps.text: What are you two doing? Do you require my assistance?

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: Ohh! Perfect timing!

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: Come, come, we could use the help. I really need to dig this out.

steps.name: Beeswax
steps.text: Very well.

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: There we go!

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: I always thought you were only good for playing with sand, but turns out you're pretty handy!

steps.name: Cutter
steps.text: Ifrit, that's rude...

steps.name: Cutter
steps.text: You are always misunderstood because you say things like that.

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: Huh? Who cares what other people think about me?

steps.name: Beeswax
steps.text: Hm? Is Ifrit not offering me words of praise?

steps.name: Cutter
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Beeswax
steps.text: Is she not? Ifrit sometimes calls people 'dumbasses,' but I understand that this is also a compliment.

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: Y-you dumbass! Think before you open your big mouth!

steps.name: Beeswax
steps.text: Ah, she jumped up.

steps.name: Beeswax
steps.text: Right, and if you wish to play in the sand, I heard Dr. Gavial is about to plan a trip back home, so you should be able to go play with her. If I remember properly, there is sand near her house.

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: Who the hell wants to play in the sand? I'm not some kid!

steps.name: Beeswax
steps.text: Really? I would very much like to go. How lucky. I'm also a bit homesick, but I cannot return until I finish my journey...

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: Homesick? I dunno what that's like, but as long as I'm with Silence and Saria, anywhere is home. Is Rhodes Island not good enough?

steps.name: Beeswax
steps.text: I think our situations are a bit different... But if Ifrit is fine with it, then maybe I should be as well?

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: Tch... What's the difference then? Explain it so I can understand!

steps.name: Beeswax
steps.text: Hm... Let me think.

steps.name: Beeswax
steps.text: For me, I often... dream of my home. Of a shaking, golden cradle. Of my mother's dry and rough hand touching my cheek...

steps.name: Beeswax
steps.text: This may be nothing more than sand, and it might not be very comforting at all. But in my dreams, there's still something nostalgic about it.

steps.name: Beeswax
steps.text: It is the place to which I must ultimately return, no matter where I go.

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: Hm...

steps.name: Beeswax
steps.text: Was that clear enough of an explanation?

steps.name: Cutter
steps.text: How did we start talking about this...?

steps.name: Cutter
steps.text: All right, let's cut the chatter. I'll rebuild the stove rack, so I'll need you to prepare the new charcoal fire, Ifrit.

steps.name: Cutter
steps.text: At least, thanks to Mr. Thorns, we now know what to look out for.

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: You're right. Let's stop thinking about stuff and just get back to work.

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: Oh, that guy's name is Thorns? You'd never guess it from his looks, but he's actually a pretty nice guy.

steps.name: Beeswax
steps.text: Yes. Mr. Thorns is a very good and kind-hearted person.

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: Kind-hearted? That's a weird way to put it.

steps.name: Beeswax
steps.text: It's true! I just saw him stop a group of people who were going to harass the Doctor.

steps.name: Beeswax
steps.text: Vigna told me those people were trying to stir up trouble, but she also said there's nobody on the other side capable of fighting, so we have nothing to worry about.

steps.name: Beeswax
steps.text: I was going to go help, but it seems like that won't be needed.

steps.name: Beeswax
steps.text: Oh, that's right, Mr. Thorns also caught a thief!

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: Huh. He always has that nasty, arrogant look on his face, but he actually does stuff like that? Like, he helps people for fun? Wow.

steps.name: Cutter
steps.text: I thought he was the kind of person I'd never get along with, but it turns out I was jumping to conclusions.

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: Yeah...

steps.name: Thorns
steps.text: It's best to make sure that the person you're discussing is not within earshot before speaking so loudly.

steps.name: All Three
steps.text: Eep!

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: Why are you still here?!

steps.name: Thorns
steps.text: I just got back. Here. Pepper.

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: Oh...

steps.name: Thorns
steps.text: I'll be going. No need to thank me.

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: Wh-who the hell would thank you anyway?!

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: Ugh, what a weirdo.

steps.name: Beeswax
steps.text: He may be strange... but he truly is a good person, no?

steps.name: Thorns
steps.text: The sea? That's not quite right. Compared to the sea, this is too humane. Other than the slight salinity of the water, what else tastes of the sea?

steps.name: Thorns
steps.text: Hey.

steps.name: Thorns
steps.text: Hey, I know you're there.

steps.name: Thorns
steps.text: ....Hey. Speak. You've been standing behind me for quite some time now.

steps.name: Aya
steps.text: No way! How'd you catch me...? You must be pretty awesome to be able to sniff me out.

steps.name: Aya
steps.text: So, what do you think of the view? Not bad, huh?

steps.name: Thorns
steps.text: ...The singer from that band. What are you doing here?

steps.name: Aya
steps.text: Huh? You know who I am? Are you a fan? Want my autograph?

steps.name: Thorns
steps.text: Not really. Don't change the subject.

steps.name: Aya
steps.text: Aww, that's too bad then. Do you want a CD then?

steps.name: Thorns
steps.text: No thanks.

steps.name: Aya
steps.text: I'm just joking. Who just keeps CDs on them anyway? Has anyone ever told you you're kind of a wet blanket?

steps.name: Thorns
steps.text: Yes.

steps.name: Aya
steps.text: Listen, you're not a wet blanket. You just don't care.

steps.name: Aya
steps.text: I'm here to appreciate the ocean.
The songstress gazes out to where the sky meets the sea. Her hair sways in the sea breeze, taking on the shape of the waves.

steps.name: Aya
steps.text: But this is no ocean.

steps.name: Aya
steps.text: Siesta's beach is beautiful. The more beautiful it is, the more I'm convinced it's not like the sea at all. The place we come from is nothing like this at all.

steps.name: Aya
steps.text: People who come here to see the ocean will definitely feel cheated.

steps.name: Aya
steps.text: Do you ever miss home, Mister?

steps.name: Thorns
steps.text: Songstress, what are you actually here for?

steps.name: Aya
steps.text: You still don't get it? Don't dwell on it too much, I'm just shooting from the hip here. I say whatever's on my mind. It's a bad habit I can't kick.

steps.name: Thorns
steps.text: Don't avoid the question. You're an Ægir.

steps.name: Aya
steps.text: That I am.

steps.name: Aya
steps.text: But I also am not.

steps.name: Thorns
steps.text: I really dislike when people speak in riddles.

steps.name: Aya
steps.text: How about you ask me directly then?

steps.name: Aya
steps.text: What, weren't you going to ask me something? This is a really special opportunity, you know~

steps.name: Thorns
steps.text: Weirdo. Waste of time.

steps.name: Aya
steps.text: Didn't we all come here to waste some time? Being able to treat yourself and waste time is what I call a good life.

steps.name: Aya
steps.text: If you're out there just trying to survive, you don't get a chance to waste anything.

steps.name: Thorns
steps.text: Maybe you're right.

steps.name: Aya
steps.text: See? Want my autograph?

steps.name: Aya
steps.text: Give in already. Here, let me just grab something to write on... like this poster...
The pink-haired Ægir scribbles swiftly on the poster.

steps.name: Aya
steps.text: Here. My autograph!

steps.name: Thorns
steps.text: Hey.

steps.name: Aya
steps.text: It's a reward for talking with me, okay? It's not every day I meet someone like me, from the old country, in the outside world.

steps.name: Thorns
steps.text: No. You're wrong...

steps.name: Thorns
steps.text: I'm not like you.
Thorns opens his eyes wide and looks directly into the singer's pupils.
The singer blinks, her gaze following Thorns's hand as it slowly crawls towards the hilt of his sword.
—You didn't even try to hide it.

steps.name: Aya
steps.text: You aren't a big fan of our songs... I know that.

steps.name: Aya
steps.text: But I'll still give you my autograph.

steps.name: Thorns
steps.text: Why? You...

steps.name: Aya
steps.text: Because you like to dance. There's no way someone who likes to dance could be a bad person.

steps.name: Thorns
steps.text: Sounds utterly stupid.

steps.name: Aya
steps.text: Don't be like that. It's just something I've learned from a whole bunch of people. We've all spent a long time on this patch of dirt, and we've also learned a lot.

steps.name: Aya
steps.text: You didn't grow up in the sea, did you? You're much more at home bouncing around on land than you would be in the water.

steps.name: Aya
steps.text: But you've never known its gentle side. Oh. You're not going to miss home.

steps.name: Thorns
steps.text: Iberia is my only home.

steps.name: Aya
steps.text: So, the ocean is not your home. You have no feelings for it.

steps.name: Thorns
steps.text: No.

steps.name: Thorns
steps.text: I've drunk from it. I don't swim in a lake. My ancestors went to Iberia, but they could not bear to part from the sea.

steps.name: Thorns
steps.text: I do have feelings for it. But at the same time, I fear it.

steps.name: Aya
steps.text: Yeah, thought so.

steps.name: Aya
steps.text: 'I've heard the ripples of your falling tears~♪ Your darkest nightmares, your deepest fears~♪ Your heart cracked into petals of blood...♪'

steps.name: Thorns
steps.text: What's that song?

steps.name: Aya
steps.text: Nothing special. Just something that came to mind.

steps.name: Aya
steps.text: But, I think you're right, Mister. I think you ought to be afraid of it.

steps.name: Aya
steps.text: Of course...
In the distance, the loudspeakers of Siesta begin to replay the songs from the main event of the music festival, and a familiar tune fills the air.
Elysium has been humming this song every day for two weeks now.
The song seems to be one of the masterpieces from the band the singer belongs to.
And now, the singer...
'The disguise fell off when I remembered, the scar you left me is the pain you forgot~♪
To chase after your shadow, is to chase after naught~♪ With thund'rous voices they'll rise and call your name~♪ And when they catch your scent, they'll demand to hear your shame~♪'

steps.name: Aya
steps.text: Of course, whether or not you fear it, it will come for you.

steps.name: Aya
steps.text: It is here. Let's go. Don't look back.
What is she talking about? What is that?
What is that... standing on the water?
The fractured sunset casts faintly mottled shadows upon the water, pulling back the tide in gray waves.
The sound of the world is the sound of breathing is the sound of the ocean, which you listen to without speaking or singing or breathing.
A moment passes, two moments pass, until dozens and hundreds of years pass in silence.
It gazes into you.
Its eyes bore into yours, yearning to slowly crawl in through your wounds.
You are awake as it pulls you into its embrace and you sink into its blood and shadow and sun and hear its eyeless and soundless and lifeless shadow.
As tranquil as a shining star.

steps.name: Aya
steps.text: Under the surface, there's a waterway that connects to the ocean... It isn't strange that it gives off some ocean vibes.

steps.name: Aya
steps.text: Hey. Hey, Mister, wake up. Snap out of it already.

steps.name: Aya
steps.text: Hmph. I couldn't hypnotize you with my song. That makes me a bit jealous.

steps.name: Thorns
steps.text: You're the one who should go.

steps.name: Aya
steps.text: Huh? Ah... that couldn't be, yeah? Look, you know that...

steps.name: Thorns
steps.text: That's not something that should be here. If you go now, you won't die.

steps.name: Aya
steps.text: I know, but... aren't you the one who's supposed to leave right now?

steps.name: Thorns
steps.text: Do you have a death wish?

steps.name: Aya
steps.text: Listen to me carefully...
Æ...gir.

steps.name: Aya
steps.text: Don't be scared. It shouldn't be surprising that the ocean knows our names.

steps.name: Thorns
steps.text: ...No

steps.name: Thorns
steps.text: It is not awe.

steps.name: Thorns
steps.text: Urk...

steps.name: Aya
steps.text: Then what's your deal then...? Hey, are you having trouble breathing?

steps.name: Aya
steps.text: Sober up a bit, Mister.

steps.name: Aya
steps.text: (Ægirian) Nothing can deprive you of the right to breathe on this land.

steps.name: Aya
steps.text: (Free yourself, hurry...!)
I fled my homeland. I abandoned my cradle. I've forgotten its stories. But I know how it feels.
I believe what I've heard whispered in legend. Even in shallow dreams, I've felt the bite of swords rending their bodies.
Can I slay the sea itself?
I am homesick. Rather, I've imagined it before. But I've never actually seen home.
We Iberians have long left the depths of the Abyss.
But I cannot escape from It. None of us can escape from It.
I want to kill It.

steps.name: Thorns
steps.text: Is this a hallucination?

steps.name: Aya
steps.text: Nope. But you can fight it.

steps.name: Thorns
steps.text: You seem quite knowledgeable about these?

steps.name: Aya
steps.text: Is this really the time to be having that discussion? I told you, you should leave now.

steps.name: Aya
steps.text: Hey, are you trembling?

steps.name: Thorns
steps.text: Maybe I'm getting a bit excited.

steps.name: Thorns
steps.text: Stay if you want. You said I like dancing. What about you then...

steps.name: Thorns
steps.text: Songstress, do you also like to dance?
(The sound of bones and flesh and viscera being crushed together)
(A vague, sickening sound)

steps.name: Aya
steps.text: I love it!

steps.name: Aya
steps.text: Seems like you don't plan to leave then. So, Mr. Ægir, are you confident you can survive?

steps.name: Thorns
steps.text: Yes.

steps.name: Aya
steps.text: Will you show me then? I want to see the dance you're about to dance, one that will paint the sea red...

steps.name: Aya
steps.text: Yes, flourish the sword that weaves with your bounding steps! Spin, pirouette, and glide across the ocean's surface! Whether you are torn apart or you tear It apart, the beginning or end of your story...

steps.name: Thorns
steps.text: You know, the way you talk is really annoying.

steps.name: Aya
steps.text: I don't know! I think it's perfectly fine!

steps.name: Aya
steps.text: So, will you show me your performance, Mr. Ægir? Look at that autograph I just gave you. Just let me know, okay?

steps.name: Thorns
steps.text: ...As long as you're not afraid, be my guest.

steps.name: Thorns
steps.text: It's good to have an audience, no matter who you might be.

steps.name: Thorns
steps.text: Huh? I feel like it should be said here—

steps.name: Thorns
steps.text: —I'd be honored.

steps.name: Aya
steps.text: Ahaha, that's not much of a line... But anyway, you have to live on, Mister.

steps.name: Aya
steps.text: I can tell you really care about this. So you have to live on. Don't die.

steps.name: Thorns
steps.text: I don't plan to die. There's a friend who wants your autograph, and I have to stay alive to bring it back.

steps.name: Aya
steps.text: Back, to Iberia?

steps.name: Thorns
steps.text: No. Though I've mentioned Iberia, I've also mentioned the sea that my ancestors could not live without.

steps.name: Thorns
steps.text: But perhaps, my home is no longer in either of those places.
